en: The image shows an old postcard with a sepia tone, likely from the early 20th century. There is a stamp featuring a portrait of a military officer in uniform. The card is filled out in Latin script and features printed text in Hungarian (Neve, Címe, A feladó) and German (Name, Adresse, Absender, Correspondenzkarte). The postcard also contains official military rubber stamps, indicating it was sent by field post (Feldpost). Handwritten addresses are present as well.
